TOP: Roundcube pre-auth SQL injection actively exploited
macOS screen-sharing flaw plants root crypto miner
Bouncy Castle flaw breaks MLS authentication

P.h: Roundcube pre-auth SQL injection is under active attack
P.p: Unauthenticated attackers are exploiting CVE-2026-48842 in Roundcube Webmail 1.6.0 through 1.6.15 and 1.7.0. The flaw sits in the built-in virtuser_query plugin and lets them run arbitrary database commands and read sensitive data.
P.s: Update to 1.6.16 or 1.7.1 now, or disable the plugin if you cannot patch today. Internet-facing webmail should be treated as exposed until then.

items.h: macOS screen-sharing bug (CVE-2026-65400) used to plant a root Monero miner
items.d: Attackers hit an exposed port 5900. Apple patched Tahoe, Sequoia and Sonoma last week. Ben Thompson found automatic updates skipped the point release carrying the fix.

items.h: Bouncy Castle CVE-2026-71885 breaks MLS group authentication
items.d: Improper certificate validation in Java versions before 1.86 lets attackers spoof participants and decrypt messages. Upgrade to 1.86.

items.h: Dell System Update flaw gives unauthenticated root (CVE-2026-86360)
items.d: Path traversal on PowerEdge servers, plus four more high-severity DSU bugs. None exploited so far. Upgrade to DSU 2.3.0.0 or later.

items.h: Denmark's population register breached, 8.8M people exposed
items.d: Names, addresses and CPR numbers were accessed, reportedly with a Danish company's legitimate login credentials.

P.h: Oracle shows how to give AI agents access without giving up control
P.p: Oracle preserves employee permissions across MCP connections and limits coding and operations agents through temporary access, least privilege and human approval for sensitive actions. It is a practical model for enforcing authorization in backend systems as agents move from reading to doing.
P.s: Related: the open-source Coi tool isolates agents such as Claude Code or Codex in Incus containers, and pauses or kills a container when it detects compromise.
